title: Create With JGamer
description: This is my official modpack with Create mod, hope you enjoy it!
body:
This is a new project i began to make my own server with a modpack, it all began since i started joining Create SMP's, there were nice and cool. So i wanted to make my own! And yes this is my first project of making a Create SMP with modpack and all those things, currently i am still developing on the server side things so for now that will be unavailable, but the pack just had its **First Release!** and i am obviously happy with it, it works for what i tested no crashes and it looks nice with shaders. I tried to fit as many create mods into it that i think are pretty awesome, if there are some missing which you think need to be in my pack, join the discord and let me know!

It features a ton of Create mods: (These listed are just a couple)
- Create: Aeronautics
- Create: Big Cannons
- Create: Coblestone (Cobble generators powered by SU)
- Create: Jetpack
- Create: Bitterballen (For the dutch)
- Create: Connected
- Create: Copycats+
- Create: Enchantment industry
- Create: Enchantable machinery
- Create: Numismatics (For the currency/money)
- Create: Powerloader

And much more!

I pre-loaded it with a couple shaders to choose from, if your shader liking is not in it let me know because i will add it!

I also with the most recent update (1.1.0) of my pack i added: Sophisticated backpacks, for the players who like it!

And yes it also features Waystones if you were wondering!

Come check it out, join the discord and let me know what you think of it!
